# Quotation response -- KR-RFQ-2026-11

Visakoivu Oy -- technical maintenance services, Ryhtila production and office facility

## Eligibility

2.1 Turnover for FY2025 was EUR 20,300,000, above the EUR 3,000,000 threshold set in this request.

2.2 Electrical professionals employed in-house exceed the minimum of 15 required under Section 2.

2.4 Valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate held at the time of submission.

## Technical response

3.1 Environmental impacts during works, including waste, emissions and noise, are managed under our environmental management procedures.

3.2 Scheduled HVAC maintenance follows an agreed calendar for the contract period, covering the production hall, machine shop and office areas.

3.3 Building envelope condition, including roofing and cladding, is assessed periodically as part of the maintenance scope.

3.4 Internal quality control and testing procedures apply to all completed maintenance and repair work.

3.6 Personnel observe the Buyer's site-access and security procedures at all times when working within the production facility.

3.7 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is programmed for the facility on the applicable statutory cycle.

3.8 Maintenance visits follow an agreed content and frequency, confirmed with the Buyer's facilities contact at contract start.

3.9 The existing asset register and technical documentation will be received from the Buyer, checked against site condition, and maintained current throughout.

3.10 Commissioning and testing follow our standard protocol after any equipment replacement, with results recorded for the Buyer's file.

3.11 A method statement will be provided for installation work carried out at the facility, sequenced to limit disruption.

3.13 Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on a scheduled basis appropriate to each system.

3.15 Condition-monitoring data is collected and reported to the Buyer's facilities contact as agreed.

3.16 Common spare parts are held in stock, with lead times confirmed to the Buyer on request.

## Commercial terms

4.1 A retention percentage, where applicable, will be stated in the pricing schedule submitted alongside this response.

4.3 Invoicing is monthly and available electronically, in a format compatible with standard accounting systems.

4.4 Subcontractor costs, where used, are made transparent to the Buyer on request.

4.5 Pricing distinguishes fixed-price maintenance visits, unit-priced parts and materials, and time-based call-out charging.

4.7 A cost breakdown supporting the headline price quoted is enclosed with this response.

## Forms enclosed

Description of the quality system in use.

## Format

6.2 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, as required by this request.

6.5 The quotation is submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

A.3 Site personnel hold the trade qualifications and site-induction requirements needed to work safely in the production areas.

A.6 An on-call arrangement is maintained outside normal working hours, with response times set by severity category.

A.7 Response times for corrective, non-emergency maintenance requests are stated separately from the fault-response times above.

Visakoivu Oy
